name: Life And Godliness
overview: Scripture reveals that life and godliness are rooted in God's sovereign knowledge and purpose for each individual, as He ordains and sanctifies us even before birth (Jeremiah 1:5). Our confidence in God's power, demonstrated by the impossibility of nothing with Him (Luke 1:37), calls us to faith—believing in His existence and His reward for those who diligently seek Him (Hebrews 11:6). This faith leads to salvation through confessing Jesus as Lord and trusting in His resurrection (Romans 10:9), enabling believers to receive every spiritual blessing in Christ (Ephesians 1:3) and to seek wisdom from God, who generously provides it to His children (James 1:5).
